descriptor: Export and distribution of Korean cosmetics; own brands TENZERO and MOOLDA
about: ARTFACE is a Korean cosmetics export and distribution company. Starting with exclusive contracts with Daewoong and Dongsung Pharmaceutical, the company grew into a specialised exporter and launched two of its own brands: TENZERO for skincare and MOOLDA for colour cosmetics.

TENZERO is the company's flagship brand: more than 300 products addressing a range of skin needs at an accessible price without compromising quality. The brand name stands for “Ten beauty needs & Zero concern”. In 2023 a flagship store opened on the main street of the Myeongdong district in Seoul.

The brand's products are available in North and South America, Japan, Europe, Russia and Southeast Asia — through retail chains, duty-free stores and online channels. The company takes part in industry trade shows and operates its own distribution and warehouse logistics.

lines.name: TENZERO — Signature and PDRN care
lines.note: Premium ampoule products based on PDRN and collagen: the Hidden Shot 2500 concentrate, a dual spray-ampoule, the Deep Aqua Collagen 2X line, capsule creams and elixirs.

lines.name: TENZERO — Care by skin type
lines.note: Toner·essence·cream·serum ranges targeting a specific need: Active, Vitamin, Green Caviar, Blemish Cica, 24K Gold, Glow Vita, Glow Rice and Yuja.

lines.name: TENZERO — Sun care and makeup on a PDRN base
lines.note: Sun cushions, creams and sticks, as well as foundations and cushions based on PDRN and collagen.

lines.name: TENZERO — Cleansing
lines.note: Cleansing oils, cleansing balms, foams, micellar water, peeling gels and cleansing wipes.

lines.name: TENZERO — Masks, patches and targeted care
lines.note: Sheet and ampoule masks, collagen wrapping masks, hydrogel patches, pads and spot patches for problem areas.

lines.name: TENZERO — Body, hands and hair
lines.note: Hand creams, body gels and lotions, scrubs, foot care, as well as shampoos, essences and tonics for hair and scalp.

lines.name: MOOLDA — colour cosmetics
lines.note: ARTFACE's own colour cosmetics brand. Brand materials are provided on request.

tech.name: PDRN and collagen
tech.note: Signature formulas based on PDRN (polynucleotides) and collagen — the Hidden Shot 2500 concentrate, the Deep Aqua Collagen 2X line, PDRN foundations and cushions.

tech.name: Actives by skin need
tech.note: Products with green caviar (sea grape) extract, centella (Cica), vitamin C, 24K gold, rice and yuja — for hydration, radiance, sebum control and soothing.

tech.name: A full care routine from a single brand
tech.note: Skincare, sun care, cleansing, masks, makeup, body and hair — more than 300 TENZERO items in a unified visual style.

tech.name: Export and distribution
tech.note: Experience in export and distribution across retail, duty-free and online in the Americas, Japan, Europe, Russia and Southeast Asia; own warehouse logistics.

exportNote: TENZERO products are available in North and South America, Japan, Europe, Russia and Southeast Asia — through retail chains, duty-free stores and online channels. The brand's profile and materials are published on the Teranova platform; export terms are arranged through Teranova.

terms.label: Cooperation formats
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished products under the TENZERO and MOOLDA brands. Private-order formats are clarified at the deal stage.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: Clarified by brand and item at the deal stage.

terms.label: Pricing
terms.value: Export prices on request. The volumes shown on the pages are for reference only.

terms.value: Request → Teranova review and approval → negotiations and samples → turnkey logistics, customs and payment.

consentNote: The data and materials are provided by ARTFACE CO.,LTD (brands TENZERO and MOOLDA) and are published with its written consent. The manufacturer's direct contacts are not disclosed. Teranova coordinates and supports the deal.
